title: fix(objectql)!: a bare doc read refuses a name two enabled packages hold, naming both
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #33264

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — narrowed: a by-name read of a doc that names no package (`GET /meta/doc/NAME` and the doors that read through it, `MetadataFacade.get`/`getEntry`), of a name two or more enabled packages hold, moves from one holder's body, picked by registration order, to `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder. Unchanged: one holder, a read that names the package, the environment's own item.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` (the `/meta` 409 section) already teaches that an ambiguous bare read answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` listing the holders; this PR makes the doc read honour it. The `?package=` remedy for a doc on a composed artifact server is tracked in #34040 / #34041.
Follow-ups named by ruling 6893582352: #34069 (domain:skills, ADR-0048 status line) and #34070 (domain:ui, Console `/docs/NAME` candidates on a 409). Composed-rig pins (review N2/N6) are carried by #34040 (acceptance item 4).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两个启用的包都带同名帮助文档(doc)时,不指明包的按名读取(REST `/meta/doc/名字` 与进程内 `MetadataFacade.get`)不再按注册顺序随便给一份,而是回 409 并列出所有持有包。
- 为什么改:落实裁决 6893582352(选项 A「拒绝并列出候选」):有歧义就报出来,不猜;与已经拒绝的裸保存、删除、发布、分层读取对齐。
- 风险与回滚:只影响「两个及以上启用包同名 doc」这一情形,一方实测零存量;单持有者、指明包的读取、环境自己的 doc 都不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `readBareDoc`(判定本身);`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts` 的 `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` 调用点(在任何层读取之前);`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts -t ruling`,预期 7 个用例(按两种注册顺序展开共 12 个)全部通过。
- 需要你做的:按 Clause-② 收窄面安排一次契约复审(contract review)。

## What changes

The ruling on #33264 (comment 6893582352, option A) chose: a context-free read of a `doc` name held by two or more enabled packages answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder, at the REST door and the in-process facade. `doc` stays in ADR-0150 D1 bucket 1; no address form changes.

- `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`: `SchemaRegistry.resolveItem('doc', name)` with no caller package goes through a new private `readBareDoc`. It counts the served holders with `packageScopedHoldersOf` (a disabled package holds no name) and throws `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`ambiguous-in-environment`, the same refusal the package-scoped types give) when two or more hold the name. A package-less bare-slot entry (the environment's own item) answers first, as `getItem` served it. With one enabled holder beside a disabled one, it answers the enabled holder's item; otherwise it is `getItem`, unchanged. `MetadataFacade.get` / `getEntry` / `exists` already read through `resolveItem`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`: `readMetaItem` asks that judge (`refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead`) before any layer is read, for a read naming no package of type `doc`. It is a judge only: when the registry answers, the read's layers run exactly as before.

Seam: both. Measured on a composed server (below), the REST bare read never reached the registry for this answer: the metadata service keeps a doc by name alone and answered the package registered LAST. So a registry-only judge would have missed the REST door, and a protocol-only judge would have missed the facade. The judge lives once, in the registry; the protocol only asks it.

| Read | FROM (origin/main) | TO (this PR) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME`, two enabled holders (composed server: dispatcher and RestServer; `/layers` and `/published` too) | `200`, the holder registered last | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, both holders named |
| `MetadataFacade.get('doc', NAME)` / `getEntry`, two enabled holders | the holder registered first | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (`PackageScopedNameRefusedError`), both named |
| `MetadataFacade.exists('doc', NAME)`, two enabled holders | `true` | `true` (unchanged) |
| one holder; `?package=`; a package caller; the environment's own item | as before | as before |
| `MetadataFacade.get`, two holders, one disabled | the first registered (may be the disabled one's) | the enabled holder's |
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME`, two holders, one disabled | `404` when the disabled one registered last, else the enabled one's | unchanged |

## Tests

New top-level describe in the shared harness `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` (real `SchemaRegistry`, real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, real `MetadataFacade`), every two-holder pin in both registration orders. Refusal pins assert `code` `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `status` `409`, the reason and each holder named.

- FROM one holder's body TO 409: the protocol read on both faces, the facade (`get`, `getEntry`) and the registry refuse; `exists` stays `true`.
- FROM the service's copy TO 409: with a metadata service that keeps the doc registered last, the read is refused before that layer is read.
- A package-less row only the store holds is no exemption: the read's layers do not serve such a row for a `doc` (measured), so exempting it would reopen the registration-order pick.
- CONTROLs: one holder at every reader; the exact address and the package caller read their own holder in both orders; a disabled package holds no name (the facade serves the enabled one, re-enabled it refuses again); the environment's own item answers first beside two holders.

Ablation, each leg through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved, restored blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty), pins run with `-t ruling`:

<details><summary>Four legs, each red, each restored</summary>

- A, the registry refusal never fires (`served.length >= 2` to `>= 99`): 7 failed, 5 passed. Red: both FROM pins in both orders, the disabled-holder CONTROL (it asserts the refusal on re-enable) and the store-only-row pin.
- B, the protocol never asks the judge (`request.type === 'doc'` to `'docABLATED'` in `readMetaItem`; `metadata-protocol` rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in `dist/`): 5 failed, 7 passed, each `the read refuses: expected undefined to be an instance of PackageScopedNameRefusedError`. Restored, rebuilt, preflight `--absent` passes on all 24 built files and the tree.
- C, a disabled package counts as a holder (`includeDisabledPackages: true`): 2 failed (the disabled-holder CONTROL, both orders).
- D, the environment's own item no longer answers first: 2 failed (the environment CONTROL, both orders).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Reading of the ruling's "the environment's own saved row still answers first": the row answers first where the registry holds it (the package-less bare slot that hydration and the save write). A row only the store holds is not served by the read's layers for a `doc` (step 1 does not adopt it, measured on the composed server and on the harness), so it is not an exemption: exempting it measured `200` with the holder registered last. Named in the report.
- Out of this PR, measured on origin/main on the composed server and unchanged here: `GET /meta/doc/NAME?package=com.qa.alpha` answers the OTHER package's doc (the one the metadata service kept); and with one holder disabled and registered last, the bare read, `/layers` and `/published` answer `404` although an enabled package holds the name. Both are in the report for the seat.
- Owed elsewhere, per the ruling: the ADR-0048 status-line edit (a `domain:skills` card) and the Console `/docs/NAME` display of the candidates on a 409 (a UI-lane follow-up).

## Verification

All readings at head `e4b68eb2b` (this branch with `origin/main` merged at `db1dde9f`), objectstack-ai/objectstack.

<details><summary>Composed server: the mechanism, measured before and after</summary>

A throwaway rig (not committed) booted the way a compiled artifact composes: `MetadataPlugin` artifact door plus `AppPlugin` over one artifact whose two package bodies (`com.qa.alpha`, `com.qa.beta`) each ship doc `shared_doc`; both transports (`HttpDispatcher.dispatch` and `RestServer`'s registered handler), both registration orders.

- origin/main `1e65a389`: the metadata service holds the doc registered LAST; the registry's `getItem` answers the one registered first. The bare read, `/layers` and `/published` all answered `200` with the LAST registered holder's doc, in both orders. So the PM hypothesis H1 (the REST read ends at the registry's first composite) is refuted for this door, and H2 (one judge at the registry covers both doors) holds only because the protocol now asks that judge before any layer.
- this head: the bare read, `/layers` and `/published` answer `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` on both transports, in both orders. One holder disabled: identical to main on every door (`404` when the disabled one registered last, the enabled one's doc otherwise). A package-less `sys_metadata` row only the store holds: `409` (with an exemption it answered `200` with the last registered holder's doc, because the read's layers do not serve such a row for a doc).

</details>
